title: Leading & Kerning
slide_intent: Use a letter-based spacing unit so multiline headlines remain readable as they scale.
strategic_value: Spacing derived from TeleNeo can give T-Mobile headlines consistent rhythm across media.
demonstration: Two magenta headlines on black show cap lines, baselines and spacing based on the arm of E.
practical_value: Measure leading from the displayed letter anatomy and inspect for crowding instead of tightening letters until they touch.

content_islands.name: Spacing explanation
content_islands.spec: Place leading and kerning guidance in a white left column.

content_islands.name: Measured headline examples
content_islands.spec: Stack two magenta headlines on black with baseline/cap-line guides and E-arm measurements.

ingredient.name: TeleNeo spacing
ingredient.role: Separate lines and letters enough for a headline to read clearly.
ingredient.application: Use the E arm as the leading unit; examples show 1.5 arm units between lines. Keep kerning generally at zero points for static headlines and prevent touching letters.
ingredient.scope: Static headline guidance; baseline and cap line define the measurement boundaries.
